I'm excited to share that I'm open to new opportunities as a Senior Data Engineer or Data Platform Lead in the healthcare and biotech space. With my background in designing and implementing scalable analytics warehouses, I'm confident in my ability to drive business value through data-driven insights.

Recently, I worked on a project where I designed a star schema for a healthcare analytics warehouse using AWS Redshift and dbt. I utilized Redshift's powerful querying capabilities, including the use of Common Table Expressions (CTEs) and window functions, to optimize data retrieval and aggregation. To further improve performance, I implemented data partitioning and sorting using Redshift's DISTKEY and SORTKEY configurations.

I've also leveraged Databricks and PySpark to build scalable ETL pipelines, integrating with tools like Apache Airflow for workflow management and GitHub Actions for CI/CD. My experience with designing data warehouses has taught me the importance of a well-structured star schema, including fact and dimension tables, to support fast and efficient querying.

If you're looking for a seasoned data engineer who can help drive your healthcare or biotech organization's analytics capabilities forward, let's connect. I'm excited to explore new opportunities and collaborate with like-minded professionals. Feel free to share this post with your network or reach out to me directly to start a conversation.
